bibl.title: From the Ptolemies to Augustus: Mediterranean integration into the Indian Ocean trade.
bibl.seg: Matthew Adam Cobb, From the Ptolemies to Augustus: Mediterranean integration into the Indian Ocean trade.
Matthew Adam Cobb (ed.), The Indian Ocean Trade in Antiquity. Political, Cultural and Economic Impacts (Abingdon - New York, 2019) pp. 17-51, figg.
bibl.note: The development of Ptolemaic-era trade in the Erythrea Thalassa: Early Ptolemaic trade; - Voyages over the open ocean; - The growth in trade; - Ptolemaic monopolies; - Forts, ports and desert routes. - Developments in the Augustan period: Construction activity at Myos Hormos and Berenike; - New participants and finance; - Augustan military and diplomatic innovations; Administrative reforms. - Conclusions.
